name: object-counts-divider-drag-missing-card
description: A split card that core.grid does not report fails the divider drag with the cards that the grid reports.
reason: The case plays the commands and the waits of the operations of an object-count measurement, which run sok processes and a client of the endpoint on a workbench that the replay cannot arrange.

commands.name: core.card.split
commands.description: Splits a card and puts a new tab of a plugin in a new card on the named side of it: left, right, top, or bottom.
